text:
liam: main pipeline turned red right after merge of PR #3421 (model-serving tweaks). failing step: `smoke-gpu-e2e` — logs https://ci.internal/red/6170001234 :eyes:
maya: ack, grabbing logs now. link looks like `kvalloc` OOM in allocator init in shard-2
ci-bot: Build 6170001234 started. failing job: smoke-gpu-e2e (exit code 137). archived logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/6170001234/smoke-gpu-e2e.log
kevin: who owns the PR? @liam are those serving changes gated?
liam: owner is me, I merged because tests were green locally + one flaky pass in CI. not seeing the OOM locally — possible scale difference.
maya: can someone trigger a rerun quick? if it's flaky a rerun might clear it.
liam: requesting rerun now — `ci rerun 6170001234 --job smoke-gpu-e2e`
ci-bot: Rerun requested by liam. queued job id 6170001290.
oncall-jen: i'm oncall, i'll watch. can we hold rollouts if this keeps happening?
kevin: yes, if rerun flakes again we should hold the deployment and consider revert. also we should check whether the PR bumped batch sizes or changed image.
maya: skim of PR shows a small allocator tweak and bump to `DEFAULT_BATCH=32` in config. that could affect memory.
liam: ah ok, i missed that when merging. will revert the batch bump if rerun fails again.
ci-bot: Rerun 6170001290 started. current status: running smoke-gpu-e2e container on shard-3.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: smoke-gpu-e2e FAILED (OOM kill).
kevin: OOM again. can someone bisect the PR? only one commit in the merge though (squash). quick suggestion: roll back the `DEFAULT_BATCH` change and run smoke locally with `--parallel-shards=3`
maya: i'll try a quick revert PR now and run headless smoke on a smaller cluster.
liam: thanks. tagging revert PR link when created. if maya confirms repro, i'll ship revert and we can backfill a safer batch change with a feature flag.
kevin: also add a short note for the release thread so SRE knows we triggered a hot revert if needed.
maya: revert created: https://git.internal/r/repo/pulls/3430 — running smoke against revert now.
ci-bot: Job 6170001402 (smoke against revert) queued.
ci-bot: Job 6170001402 SUCCEEDED. smoke-gpu-e2e green on revert branch.
liam: good — i'll open a rollback and tag infra. thanks all for quick help :thumbsup:
oncall-jen: noted. putting a short hold on automatic rollout until we confirm a safe batch config. ping me if you want me to escalate to a SE for allocation tuning.
kevin: follow-up: add a small test to the CI matrix that exercises `DEFAULT_BATCH=32` in a constrained env so we don't regress silently.
liam: adding ticket to backlog and will create the PR after rollback is merged. closing loop here.
